title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-claude-creation-destruction-doctrine: carry parked/claude/creation-destruction-doctrine onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/claude/creation-destruction-doctrine` at f546d5f2a4 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: GLOSSARY.md, README.md, agents/AGENTS.md, agents/PROJECT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, deploy/cloudflare-accounts.json, doctrine/glossary.json)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/claude/creation-destruction-doctrine
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 1 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried parked/claude/creation-destruction-doctrine

**Evidence:** Ported: the rule itself is on main as BOUNDARY-AXIOM in agents/AGENTS.md with doctrine/boundary.json and foundation/boundary.py (an enforced drill, stronger than the branch's doctrine lint); the missing glossary terms ultrastability, creation-and-destruction and containment-boundary are added to doctrine/glossary.json and GLOSSARY.md, bound to the boundary tests.
